premises.text: Connected students still cannot get classmates' help on demand, which hurts mastery and widens achievement gaps
premises.evidence_span: the most connected and social generation ever could not get help from the people they see every day in class

premises.text: Student-first social learning platform plus campus-founder and viral invite growth connects classmates for shared study resources
premises.evidence_span: we put the students first in everything that we do. So we put together a campus founder program, and we do a big marketing and social media push the first day of class

premises.text: Peer mentors recruited from the platform deliver targeted one-on-one tutoring priced affordably and placed on course pages
premises.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with, and that allows us to be highly targeted like no other

value.text: Let every college student get personalized help right when stuck
value.evidence_span: if you're stuck studying and just need a little extra help, even if it is at 11 p.m. on a Sunday, you can get help for the price of a beer

secondary_value.text: Students can earn money as peer mentors
secondary_value.evidence_span: a way for students to make some money for college

causal_links.evidence_span: Students learn best by helping each other out
in one tap, you can get the best peer mentor for you
We're able to find the best students right on our platform and invite them to become peer mentors

notes: Platform features and GTM combined as one student-network premise. Explicit platform-enables-mentors dependency coded.
